title: Multi-column build/cache amortization
question: At what repeated-use scale does the one-time self-build and cache acquisition overhead become negligible relative to the measured complete-Richards solve savings of the selected adaptive representation?

accounting.startup_overhead: one representation build per unique key plus one cache acquisition per column
accounting.runtime_benefit: measured per-solve CPU saving from the corresponding F-AHL16 material/regime evidence
accounting.break_even: smallest integer solve count for which accumulated solve saving exceeds build plus acquisition overhead

decision_rule: Report the full amortization surface. Do not hide startup cost and do not extrapolate to whole-SWAP wall time.
